question: List products and their total revenue in January 2024, highest first.
schema_ref: orders(id, product_id, amount, created_at), products(id, name)
expected_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(o.amount) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2024-02-01' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

params.output: SELECT p.name, SUM(o.amount) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2024-02-01' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: Which countries have more than one customer?
expected_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

params.output: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
